tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light is the default for the console, slides and the stage screen; Dark is for the video and night mode.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Raised areas on paper: stage panels, code and policy.yaml blocks, hovered rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, rules, the gate post and arm, redaction bars. Reads on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, units, timestamps. At least 4.5:1 on paper and paper-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Structural rules: 2px under headers and over footers, 1px between table rows.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet separators inside dense tables. Decorative only.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The only accent: block and kill, failures, the one number that matters on a slide. Text on paper.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (the kill badge).

tokens.name: redact-bar
tokens.usage: Redaction bars: the decision redact, censored words in headlines, the bar in the wordmark.

tokens.name: allow
tokens.usage: Decision allow: plain ink. Passing is the normal state and needs no colour.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Decision block: signal text.

tokens.name: kill
tokens.usage: Decision kill_session: signal fill with on-signal text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: canary
tokens.usage: The canary's body. Mascot only, never UI chrome or text.

tokens.name: canary-shade
tokens.usage: The canary's wing and tail.

tokens.name: canary-beak
tokens.usage: The canary's beak and feet.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One headline per slide or stage screen. Uppercase, condensed (font-stretch 72%).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Slide titles, section openers. Uppercase, condensed (font-stretch 72%).

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers: tiles, slide footers, the stage screen. font-stretch 80%.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every request and every answer goes through the gate.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Rule ids, hashes, keys, prompts in tables, policy.yaml.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Rule ids on slides and the stage screen.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a badge and its rule id.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, dense panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between metric groups.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.usage: Default: panels, tables, badges, redaction bars. The system is square.
